title: Cap: free Loom alternative
caption:
Loom charges $18/month to record your screen. Cap does it for free 🎥

✅ Record your screen, a window or an area, with camera + mic
✅ Built-in editor with backgrounds, auto zooms and trimming
✅ Export in 4K
✅ No subscription, runs on your computer

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ The free version is for personal use: local recordings have no time limit, and you get 25 share links a month (up to 5 min each). Work use needs a paid license

Comment "RECORD" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

#opensource #github #screenrecorder #loom #productivity #freeapps #techtips #creator
